name: TOYCON Philippines
blurb: TOYCON Philippines' annual Christmas Toys and Collectibles Fair, a toy, collectibles and cosplay holiday market at SM Megamall.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: '19TH CHRISTMAS TOYS AND COLLECTIBLES FAIR 2026 ... this December 11-13 2026 in MegaTrade Halls of SM Megamall' and '2026 CHRISTMAS TOYS AND COLLECTIBLES FAIR Unwrap the JOY December 11-13, 2026 Megatrade Halls 1-3, SM Megamall'

notes: TOYCON Philippines runs several branded events a year (TOYCON Summer Prelude, TOYCON Nexus + PopLife Festival in June at SMX Manila, a North Hobby Expo in Baguio); this file covers the flagship '19th Christmas Toys and Collectibles Fair' in December, matching the batch note. No dedicated guest/lineup page was found for this December edition (program page only lists past event recaps); it reads primarily as a toy/collectibles exhibitor fair rather than a guest-panel convention, so guests is 'none-yet' rather than assuming none will appear. Cover uses the 'toyfair-2026-pubmat' publicity poster found on the homepage, which is this edition's own promo art.
